title: Cybersecurity Threats and Risk Decisions
prerequisites: Basic account, password, file, and network vocabulary
Teacher introduction to the assigned section
objectives: Distinguish an asset, threat, vulnerability, and protection in a scenario.
Identify phishing, brute-force attacks, malware families, and DDoS attacks from evidence.
Rate probability and impact separately using scenario facts.
Recommend a specific protection and explain how it changes risk.
Save and export a reconstructable six-risk analysis.

requirements.account: No account required for module practice
requirements.storage: Progress remains in this browser and device
requirements.offline: Use printed scenario cards, a probability-impact matrix, and the six-risk analysis sheet.

formalAssessment: Separate teacher directions and rubric are required.
